title: The trip that never happened
subtitle: Cancelled booking · NS-2048
description: Northstar cancelled your booking. Its synthetic policy provides a full refund, but the first response offers only $880.

evidence.name: Booking receipt
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC RECEIPT. Booking NS-2048. Paid USD 1,408.00 on 2026-08-20. Trip date 2026-09-18. No refund recorded.

evidence.name: Cancellation confirmation
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC EMAIL dated 2026-09-12. Northstar Travel cancelled booking NS-2048 because the tour will not operate. The traveller did not cancel.

evidence.name: Cancellation policy · section 4
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC POLICY. Section 4: if Northstar cancels a tour, the full amount paid is refundable to the original payment method. No service fee is retained.

title: A warranty worth following through
subtitle: Air purifier · FM-7781
description: Your air purifier stopped working within its one-year warranty. ClaimBack assembles the claim and follows up until a replacement is confirmed.

evidence.name: Proof of purchase
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC RECEIPT. Forma Air purifier purchased 2026-02-11 for USD 349.00. Serial FM-7781.

evidence.name: Fault and troubleshooting log
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC OWNER LOG dated 2026-09-10. Device no longer powers on. Tested a working outlet, replaced the filter and performed the manual reset. No impact or water damage reported. This log is a statement, not independently verified.

evidence.name: One-year limited warranty
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC POLICY. Manufacturing defects reported within 365 days of purchase qualify for review. Receipt, serial number and troubleshooting log required. Approved claims receive a replacement at no cost; cash recovery is not promised.
